lineage.outcome: The artist can inspect truthful relationships among exact current-Version PCM assets, including whole-render level/dynamics/stereo evidence and bounded sampled spectral overlap, while N0TE preserves arrangement intent and artist judgment instead of impersonating a mixer.

instead_of_what: Do not build mixer controls, a second audio store, a masking score, an automatic EQ/pan/compression engine, or another Version/A-B system. Reuse current canonical Version Assets and existing exact engineering evidence.

implementation_contract.pair_binding: Every relationship compares two distinct canonical Assets attached to the exact same active Song current Version. Existing Song/Version/Asset fingerprints and managed-byte size checks are reused and reverified around analysis.
implementation_contract.whole_render_truth: RMS, integrated loudness, crest factor and stereo correlation remain independent engineering measurements. Their pairwise differences are evidence only and do not imply a gain, compression, width or quality recommendation.
implementation_contract.spectral_truth: Deterministic bounded FFT windows are sampled across the exact PCM material and reduced to broad-band normalized energy distributions. Histogram overlap is only a screening cue for where an engineer may listen more closely; spectral overlap is not proof of audible masking, collision or a required EQ move.
implementation_contract.consumer_truth: The normal Song page exposes a Mix Relationships card only when at least two supported exact current-Version PCM Assets exist. Private IDs, managed URIs and local paths remain hidden.
implementation_contract.mutation: Opening or rendering relationships performs no audio mutation, gain normalization, DAW/provider call, Version creation, approval change, Learning write, preference promotion or artistic decision.
